title: Defining and Calling Functions Quiz
description: Check your understanding of Defining and Calling Functions.

questions.questionText: What is the main idea of Defining and Calling Functions?

options.text: Define a function once and call it when needed.
This concept is only used for deleting files.
This concept only works inside comments.

questions.explanation: Define a function once and call it when needed.

questions.questionText: What should you do when reading a small Python example?

options.text: Read it line by line and predict the result
Ignore the order of the lines
Assume Python will fix mistakes automatically

questions.explanation: Python runs code step by step, so reading line by line helps you understand the behavior.
